# Sentinel — documentation index

Sentinel detects phishing and malicious websites through threat analysis, web security assessment, certificate validation, and collaborative threat intelligence.

## Repository documents
- PRD.md — product requirements: target user, core user flow, acceptance checks, non-goals
- DESIGN.md — visual design system & tokens (YAML) and anti-slop prose rules
- AGENTS.md — cross-agent rules: build/test commands, directory structure, component allow-list
- CLAUDE.md — persistent tool context (imports AGENTS.md)
- docs/architecture.md — system boundaries, modules, state, integrations
- docs/code-standards.md — reusable patterns and utilities
- context/progress.md — session memory: completed slices, active bugs, next steps

## Presentation layer
- index.html — single-page website: hero, URL scanner, security assessment, certificate validation, threat intelligence feed
- assets/css/style.css — design tokens + component styles
- assets/js/app.js — vanilla JS interactions

## Verification
- scripts/verify-all.mjs — full re-verification (lint + foundation + website)
- GATES.md — completion ledger with observable gates
